answer: Each agent earns reward tokens from the opal‑minted vault only after a time‑locked vesting curve tied to its identity’s age; a new identity must wait a canyon‑long interval before any payout. The protocol records a cryptographic proof of continuous operation, and every epoch increments a stake‑cost that the identity must post, payable in native gas. An attacker must front‑load the full vesting deposit for every Sybil, making large farms economically infeasible.
